title: School Access Expanded From Both Ends
hook: School grew upward and downward while one country packed the middle.
closing: School access grew at every level, changing how early learning starts and how far it can go.
question: Which school level changed most?

segments.say: Primary enrollment reached 780,852,608. The education ladder now starts with a much wider base.
India has 133,156,038 secondary students. One country now carries an enormous share of the ladder's middle.
Tertiary enrollment reached 43.6 percent. The school ladder now extends far beyond childhood.
Youth literacy reached 93.1 percent. Wider school access is translating into a near-universal basic skill.
Preprimary enrollment reached 60.9 percent. The ladder is expanding downward as well as upward.
